messages:
anya: putting up a small patch to the model catalog to clarify 'max_input_tokens' vs 'max_total_tokens' for the new Zephyr-XL card. link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12990
sam: good catch. many customers confuse those two. can you add an example illustrating token counting?
anya: added short example showing prompt + completion = total tokens. snippet:
```
prompt="A long user prompt of 1500 tokens"
max_tokens=500
# total consumed = 2000 tokens
```
elaine: also please mention how batching affects token limits: e.g. server-side batching aggregates requests but limits are per-request not global.
marco: runtime also requests we add a note about enforcement: "Requests exceeding max_total are rejected with 413" to reduce confusion.
anya: added rejection status note and a small SDK error-handling snippet.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 12990: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/12990. link-checker: 0 broken links
sam: small copy edit: change 'max_input_tokens' to snake_case everywhere in the card for consistency with the SDK fields
anya: done, pushed. merging after one more review
elaine: merged, closing thread.
docs-bot: changelog updated.
